newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover shrank to 1.5 billion yuan from 2.0 billion and the seven-day contract was the most active.
Traders said the rates moved in a narrow range in sluggish trading mainly due to the Chinese lunar new year holiday which officially begins on Thursday.

Most of China's capital markets, including the domestic A share markets, closed for the holiday on Monday and will reopen on Feburary 17. Traders said this removed major sources of short-term cash demand from the interbank market.
Traders said the rates would move in a narrow range in very slow trading on Wednesday and Thursday, the last two days of trading before the lunar new year.
